blocks.text: Imagine filling a clear glass water bottle that feels cool in your hand and keeps every sip tasting fresh and pure all day long.
550 ml capacity gives you plenty of water without feeling bulky.
Borosilicate glass stays strong and clear for pure taste.
Natural cork stopper seals cleanly and feels soft to open.
Grey silicone sleeve adds grip and gentle protection.
This reusable glass water bottle holds 550 ml, is made of borosilicate glass, comes with a natural cork stopper and grey silicone sleeve, uses BPA free materials, and is priced at 28 USD.
Take it to your desk, on walks, or to the gym for cool water that stays crisp.
Built To Last And Stay Clean
The tough borosilicate glass handles daily use well and the light design keeps weight comfortable while the smooth glass never holds onto flavors.
Glass is dishwasher safe for easy cleaning and the 550 ml size fits most bags without taking over space.
Wash the glass in the dishwasher and hand wash the cork. Avoid hot drinks or carbonated drinks so it stays perfect for years.

facts.F9: Not suitable for hot drinks or carbonated drinks
